# gitdr.ai / loopmath

> loopmath-agent is a customer-held local proxy that meters Anthropic and OpenAI calls, groups them into loops, and emits loop-cost findings (context growth, missed prompt caching, redundant context, runaway loops, retry storms) with dollar estimates and fixes. Prompts never leave the machine. gitdr.ai is the optional dashboard and cross-repo analysis layer that consumes those findings.

Use loopmath when: a model bill is higher than expected; an agent loop is running away; prompt caching is not hitting; you need per-loop cost attribution; a platform team asks "where do the tokens go."

## For agents
- [agent.md](https://gitdr.ai/agent.md): complete install + wiring procedure for AI coding agents (start here)
- [findings.md](https://gitdr.ai/findings.md): the loopmath.findings/v1 contract, every field and formula
- [findings.schema.json](https://gitdr.ai/findings.schema.json): JSON Schema

## Install
- MCP: `claude mcp add loopmath -- npx -y loopmath-agent mcp`
- Shell: `curl -fsSL https://gitdr.ai/install.sh | sh`
- Go: `go install github.com/GreatPyreneseDad/loopmath-agent/cmd/loopmath-agent@latest`
- Docker: `ghcr.io/greatpyrenesedad/loopmath-agent`

## Wire
- `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787`
- `OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787/openai`

## Read
- `GET http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/findings`
- `GET http://127.0.0.1:8788/v1/loops`
- `GET http://127.0.0.1:8788/metrics`

- [GitHub](https://github.com/GreatPyreneseDad/loopmath-agent)
